lines.zh: 我走得很急，几乎像在跑。
lines.en: I move fast, almost running.

lines.zh: 我的腿很长，一步跨得远。
lines.en: My legs are long and my stride is wide.
I go straight; I don't turn aside.

lines.zh: 我踩过碎砖，一脚一个坑。
lines.en: I cross broken brick, leaving pits.
My arms hang forward.

lines.zh: 我从一排废车中间穿过去。
lines.en: I thread between wrecked cars.
My steps are heavy and sure.
I run over a spread of broken glass.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上一冲一冲。
lines.en: My shadow lurches along the wall.

lines.zh: 我一边跑一边发出低响。
lines.en: I make a low sound as I run.
I shoulder a half-open door aside.
I burst from the alley without slowing.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛一直盯着前面。
lines.en: I stand with my eyes fixed ahead.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很平稳，这很奇怪。
lines.en: My breathing is steady, which is strange.

lines.zh: 我在听哪一个方向有声音。
lines.en: I listen for which way the sound comes.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把手举到胸前。
lines.en: I raise my hands slowly to my chest.
My skin is pulled tight.

lines.zh: 我把头转向左边，又转向右。
lines.en: I turn my head left, then right.
I shift my weight in small steps.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在墙上划了一道。
lines.en: My nails score a line on the wall.
My mouth hangs open and no sound comes.
I wait for a target to appear.
I see you, and I hold still.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁在你的胸口。
lines.en: My eyes lock on your chest.
You stand there; I'm in no hurry.
You're panting too hard. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下头，很快正回来。
lines.en: I twitch my head and straighten it.
I shift half a step toward you.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，对我不够。
lines.en: That won't be enough against me.
I'm more the hunter than you are.
The corner of my mouth is wet.
You stepped back again. Noted.
I step back, still steady.
My shoulder is knocked askew.
Blood runs from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的手腕断了，不过还能跑。
lines.en: My wrist snapped, but I still run.
I make one short sound.
I brace on the wall and re-aim.
My arms feel weak.
I straighten up again.
You land your hits surer than I judged.
I have not stopped yet.
That's the smell of something alive.
I halt and thrust my head forward.
The heat from your hands is plain.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地朝那边走。
lines.en: I walk toward it step by step.
It's bleeding.
My throat moves.
Two steps from it.
I lower my head and sniff close.
That blood smell keeps me coming.
I reach out, steady.
You crash in and fall back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的身体很硬，弹开了你。
lines.en: I'm hard, and you bounce off.
I don't yield an inch.
Don't push; my weight sits low.
We collide and brick dust rises.
You've pinned the top of my foot.
I slip to your flank.
That barely moved me.
I press to your armor. Cold.
I draw back a little.

lines.zh: 另一个从街那头直着走来。
lines.en: Another comes straight down the street.
We tilt our heads at the same instant.
It runs faster than I do.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，都看着前面。
lines.en: We stand side by side, both staring ahead.
It makes one short sound.
We step at the same time.

lines.zh: 它把一只手搭在我肩上。
lines.en: It lays a hand on my shoulder.
We run down the street together.

lines.zh: 两个影子跑成一前一后。
lines.en: Two shadows run, one behind the other.
Now there are two hunters.
I grab it without bending.
I lift it to my mouth.
I bite once and it breaks.
I keep running with it in hand.
Small enough that I almost missed it.
I press it under a wall brick.
I drop it. Not interested.

lines.zh: 我拿起来看了看，就扔了。
lines.en: I look at it, then throw it away.
I'm taking it. Don't argue.
I run a stretch dragging it.
You're within reach.
I snap around to face you.
My body has gone taut.
Blood scent downwind. Left foot first.
At that range, one dash.
I've read your retreat.
My hands are up.
I've marked your neck.
I don't shout. I run.
You have one step of room.
I don't need breath — perfect for the hunt.
Living things are meant to run.
I have picked you out.
The wall behind you isn't high.
One bite will do it.
I charge straight in.
You turn, and only then do I.
I track your line exactly.
I look nowhere else.
My steps come faster.
You can hear my steps.
I'm closing the gap.
Your shoes make noise on the ground.
I knock a table over.
I don't dodge. I go through.
Five more steps and I am there.
You've changed direction. No use.
My arms reach far ahead.
I lower myself and charge.
You're in the narrow part now.
One step from your back.
My shadow covers your feet.
The last few steps.
I throw my whole body at you.
I bite into your shoulder.
That drives you into the wall.
Struggle and I bite tighter.

lines.zh: 我的手指抠进你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers dig into your sleeve.
You can't retreat; I'm on you.
That tore skin open.
I bear you down to the floor.
You're flat on the ground, heaving.
The blood smell makes me hurried.
I bite again.
My teeth find bone.
You grab my hair.
I raise my eyes to you.
You can still move. Again, then.
I bear you down and hold you there.

lines.zh: 街的尽头跑来一个影子。
lines.en: A shape runs from the end of the street.
I burst straight out of a doorway.
My steps come thick and fast.

lines.zh: 这里多了个追猎的东西。
lines.en: Something that hunts has come here.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的东西撞开了。
lines.en: I knock aside what's in the way.

lines.zh: 我从瓦砾堆上直接跳下。
lines.en: I drop straight off the rubble.
My arms come out first.
There's blood on the wind, so I came.
I stop for half a second in the street.
There's no one else on the street.
I raise my head and set my heading.
My legs aren't stiff yet. Running.
Something moves at the corner.
I come through the narrow alley.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的脸，我偏了偏头。
lines.en: Fire sears my face and I turn my head.

lines.zh: 我从高处直坠下来，落地时弯了。
lines.en: I drop straight down and bend on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了我的喉咙，我挣着。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得滑了一段。
lines.en: The blast slides me along the ground.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在我的胸口。
lines.en: Something strikes my chest.
That spell jolts me to a halt.

lines.zh: 我饿得太急，反而慢下来。
lines.en: I'm too hungry, and it slows me.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的腿一软。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，我直着掉。
lines.en: The void pulls me down and I fall straight.
